joshua.16.p1.b1.text: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan at Jericho … through the wilderness that goes up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.

joshua.16.p1.b2.text: So Ephraim and Manasseh, the sons of Joseph, received their inheritance.

joshua.16.p1.b3.text: From Tappuah the border went westward to the Brook of Kanah and ended at the Sea. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Ephraim,

joshua.16.p1.b4.text: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. So the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day, but they are forced laborers.
